title: Extract hunk header parsing into a helper
pr_body: Small refactor so the header parsing can be unit-tested on its own.

bugs.anchor: old_count = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) is not None else 0
bugs.title: Omitted hunk counts default to 0 instead of 1
bugs.rationale: In unified diffs '@@ -5 +5 @@' means a count of 1. Defaulting to 0 makes every single-line hunk fail the count check, so those files raise DiffParseError and get no inline comments.
extra_anchors: new_count = int(match.group(4)) if match.group(4) is not None else 0
